decision: The CLI includes a context command for LLM-oriented focused context assembly: grounded context START resolves START as an exact active spec ID or deterministic search query, uses the resolved seed as the starting point, walks incoming and outgoing normalized registry edges to a bounded depth, limits the included specs, and emits Markdown or JSON. Exact active spec IDs always take precedence over search matches. When START is not an exact ID, the command uses the same deterministic search ranking as grounded search, filters fuzzy candidates to active specs, selects the top active match, lists other active matches as alternatives, and warns Markdown consumers to verify the search-resolved seed before treating the pack as authoritative. Depth 0 includes only the seed; each additional depth includes one more hop across outgoing normalized edges and inverse incoming normalized edges, including references normalized as mentions. The limit is a hard cap applied after traversal ordering, with the seed ordered first and preserved when limit is at least 1. Related specs are ordered deterministically by distance, then kind, then stable ID; this ordering is deterministic rather than relevance-optimized. Retired specs are not used as seeds or included as related context. Context item paths are rendered relative to the project root rather than as absolute local filesystem paths. The CLI rejects negative depth and limits below 1 before assembling context. The command is separate from search because search discovers candidate specs while context assembles a compact source-of-truth pack around one starting point.
name: Build focused LLM context from the CLI
description: Documents the focused CLI context command so LLM agents can gather bounded, graph-aware project memory from a specific starting point.
